title: NVStorage — objects, features and derivation operations
scope: Adopted segment-collection design, including documented Core/Runtime/Apple work and planned projection/application consumers. Each box groups domain objects with the same ownership and purpose; expanding a box lists its constituent records. SQL boxes are logical roles inside one private database.

lanes.title: Recovery & credentials
lanes.subtitle: Persistent outside the active SQL container

nodes.title: Legacy collection / explicit export
subtitle: Epoch-4 Notes & Settings
Legacy recovery journal
nodes.purpose: The legacy database and recovery journal supply the current notes for migration or explicit legacy export. Import first recovers the legacy store, then captures a consistent set of note values.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Optional remembered key
subtitle: OS-managed Keychain item
Encrypted collections
nodes.purpose: Remember on this Mac stores the encrypted collection key in a device-bound Keychain item after add-only creation and verified readback. Password and recovery-key unlocking remain independently usable.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Private unlock descriptors
subtitle: unlock/<descriptorID>.nvkey
Exact wrapped-key copies
nodes.purpose: These nonsecret unlocking descriptors sit outside the encrypted database so a password can recover the collection key before opening it. Private backups include usable copies.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Selected-store record
subtitle: selection-<associationID>.nvlocal
Active private-store locator
nodes.purpose: This durable record selects the active private store. Switching it requires a verified replacement and usable unlocking credentials; uncertain completion keeps both candidates available.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Private backup / preserved evidence
subtitle: Consistent DB + descriptors
Original DB and journals
members: Preserved original database and WAL/rollback journal
Quarantined partial salvage and displaced evidence
nodes.purpose: A private backup contains history, settings, pending file inputs and unlocking descriptors. Capture it with SQLite’s consistent backup API or by copying the complete database and required journal files while writes are stopped.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Fresh private-store candidate
subtitle: Sibling LocalStoreID
Verified replacement before activation
members: Rebuilt acceptance indexes and current rows
Validated private groups and pending links
nodes.purpose: Repair builds a new private store from validated surviving history and required private records. Reopen and verify it with usable recovery credentials before selecting it as the active store.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Repository copy / new destination
subtitle: Exact NV Data + associated files
History-preserving Save As
members: Copied descriptors and every available immutable object
Captured copy inventory and reported holes
nodes.purpose: A repository copy preserves exact history and collection identities at another location. Copying from an active session also includes its captured, durably saved local work.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Explicit plaintext scratch / export
subtitle: External editor or current-state output
Separately owned destination
nodes.purpose: Explicit external editing uses an owned plaintext file outside the encrypted repository. Export or key/profile conversion captures consistent current notes into a separately verified destination.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Application-global preferences
subtitle: Existing GlobalPrefs owner
Application / window / search defaults
nodes.purpose: The application’s existing preferences store keeps settings shared across collections. Collection-specific settings and remembered note cursor positions live in private database records.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Bootstrap / key descriptors
subtitle: NV Data/v1/keys/*.nvkey
Genesis and profile commitment
members: Argon2id salt/profile and wrapped CK for encrypted mode
nodes.purpose: Immutable descriptors identify the collection’s bootstrap and how to unlock its key. Changing a password adds another wrapping of the same key while preserving earlier unlocking routes.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Changes segment files
subtitle: segments/<epoch>/<seq>-<hash>.nvseg
Complete operation + action groups
nodes.purpose: Changes segments store exact sealed bytes for complete action groups. Their operations record creation/import, edits, deletion, recovery copies and conflict decisions.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Initial snapshot root + pages
subtitle: Snapshot envelopes in segment namespace
Committed complete initial import
nodes.purpose: The initial snapshot root and pages describe the complete imported note set and reference its history. A verified read-only preview and an editable collection require different checks.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: General snapshot root + tree
subtitle: Root → index/data pages → state stream
Logical cut + retention-parent roots
members: GeneralSnapshotRootV1: 236-byte root with eight category counts
Current values, represented frontier and action frontier
Tag 8 exact retention-parent locators; zero count when empty
nodes.purpose: A general snapshot records seven kinds of logical state at a stated set of represented operations. Its eighth v1 category names snapshot retention parents whose required objects stay stored. Reconstruction also includes every accepted operation outside the history covered by that snapshot.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Plaintext note projections
subtitle: Title.txt + optional body-bound xattr
PlaintextFilesV1
members: Separate note file exact encoded bytes and mandatory metadata
nodes.purpose: Separate note files let other applications read and edit current note values. Projection stamps identify claimed source history and exact output bytes; fresh file observations determine whether an association or update is applicable.
nodes.status: Adopted projection contract; production projection/application consumers remain Phases 6–7.

nodes.title: Owned stages / preserved displacement
subtitle: Complete sealed stage before install
Exact mutable-replacement backups
members: Operation-owned immutable-install stage at held root
nodes.purpose: Owned temporary files hold complete output before installation. Immutable installation verifies exact bytes and completes the required file/directory durability steps. Replacing a mutable file uses its separate checked-replacement contract and preserves displaced evidence.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Apple-disclosed unresolved versions
subtitle: Provider-managed external evidence
Selected plaintext members only
nodes.purpose: An explicit resolver request reads the selected unresolved provider versions. Marking a captured version resolved requires locally durable note history, verified plaintext output and a final check of that exact version.
nodes.status: OS-managed source; actual Apple/segment/projection integration remains a release gate.

nodes.title: Repository directory objects
subtitle: Selected root + visible NV Data/v1
Keys, segments and writer directories
members: Rooted directory identities and namespace entries
nodes.purpose: The selected directory contains NV Data history and any separate note files. Operations check the held directory and its named ancestors; creating directories preserves competing occupants. Collection identity and physical authority answer different questions.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Private database + pager files
subtitle: Collection.sqlite, -wal, -shm / journal
One keyed container per LocalStoreID
members: SQLCipher encrypted database pages for both profiles
nodes.purpose: One private database stores exact history, required private records, query indexes and rebuildable current-note rows. Its qualified transaction commit provides local durability. SQLite’s associated journal files follow the same recovery and backup ownership rules.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Store header / scope binding
subtitle: store_header
Collection, profile, key, bootstrap
nodes.purpose: Opening checks that the database header agrees with the selected private store, physical association and validated unlocking context.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Stored copies of exact object bytes
subtitle: objects
Stored bytes and checked locator
nodes.purpose: Each row stores one immutable object’s exact bytes under its checked identity. Receiving and retaining bytes precede acceptance of their history; accepted history and its required objects remain stored.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Committed history and prerequisites
subtitle: accepted_objects / dependencies
Atomic local accepted prefix H
members: Captured local history position and required object references
nodes.purpose: One transaction stores complete validated history, its relationships, retained-history pin, dependent-work notifications and pending-operation links. Local commit sequence numbers let current rows catch up through only the new history.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Operation and note-relationship indexes
subtitle: IDs + exact envelope occurrences
Causality and supersession separately
nodes.purpose: These indexes locate logical operations inside accepted objects. Causal parents identify observed history; note predecessors identify revisions replaced by a new note value.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Action and restoration indexes
subtitle: Scope ancestry + complete membership
Portable meaningful-action history
nodes.purpose: Action records preserve group membership, before/after values, Undo relationships and restoration provenance. Rebuildable lookup indexes support history views, copies and restoration commands.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Required retained-history record
subtitle: retained_frontier + retained_descriptors
Maximal exact object closure
members: Required object references not covered by other objects (SegmentLocator)
nodes.purpose: The retained-history pin names the history this local store has accepted and must still possess. Acceptance updates it in the same transaction. A surviving pin can reveal missing history even when current-note rows remain readable.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Durable receive work
subtitle: ready_objects / object_waits / rejected_objects
Retained, pending, accepted separated
members: Retained blocked descendants and restart obligations
nodes.purpose: This durable queue records incoming objects and the prerequisites they await. Arrival or acceptance schedules affected dependents in the same transaction. Startup handles required Changes and prerequisites before independent optional snapshots.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Required private record groups
subtitle: private_groups
Settings, association, bootstrap
nodes.purpose: These required records preserve collection settings, physical association and other private state independently of rebuildable current rows. Updates check the captured record version. Stored file receipts need fresh physical validation before another operation.
nodes.status: Core private record roles exist; platform preference/receipt interpretation and projection adapters retain separate gates.

nodes.title: Unfinished checks and known damage
subtitle: private_groups: verification/*, history-damage
Exact replay scope
members: Exact-object, accepted-prefix and bootstrap verification recipes
nodes.purpose: A verification request is saved before a check that could discover damage to accepted history. It remains pending until the complete check succeeds. Discovered damage blocks publication and replaces the request with a durable damage record.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Pending file inputs and their references
subtitle: latest + frozen payload owners
Reservations and exact settlements
nodes.purpose: The latest verified file preview and frozen inputs for admitted operations survive crashes. Transactions switch their references together. A payload is released only after every operation or preview using it has finished.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Required projection relationship state
subtitle: Accepted physical receipts / pending sources
Concrete table layout follows adapters
members: Settled external observation and exact operation linkage
nodes.purpose: Required Local State records locally observed note/file relationships. Reconciliation checks the files again and derives intended output from accepted history. The concrete storage and adapter belong to the projection implementation phase.
nodes.status: Adopted logical role; physical projection table/adapter contract remains Phase 6 work.

nodes.title: Rebuildable current-note rows
subtitle: current_notes → framed CurrentNoteCellV1
Full current values + compact context
members: All note heads and the note’s action frontier
Automatic source and deterministic conflict identity
nodes.purpose: These rebuildable rows hold current note values and editing context through a specific local history commit. They retain the exact represented revisions, including distinct revisions with equal text.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Current-view version and editing context
subtitle: view_meta / AuthoringContextV1
viewThrough ≤ acceptedThrough
members: Local history position represented by the current rows
nodes.purpose: Current rows, editing context and the represented local history position advance in one checked transaction. Rebuilding assigns a new view version so older prepared results cannot install or publish into that view.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Current-row compression dictionaries
subtitle: current_dictionaries
Immutable SHA-256-addressed zstd bytes
nodes.purpose: Compression dictionaries and the current rows using them install in the same transaction. A missing or invalid named dictionary requires rebuilding the current view from healthy retained history.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Accepted-file scan hints
subtitle: Rebuildable private_groups entries
Path + fingerprint → accepted object
members: Exact accepted-object ID and hint codec
nodes.purpose: Previously checked file fingerprints and exact accepted-object identities help discovery skip unchanged file bodies, including after reopening. Each use still checks the current rooted observation, accepted membership and session permission.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Recoding / maintenance job state
subtitle: Captured rows, dictionaries, cursor
One cancellable VACUUM reservation
nodes.purpose: Optional jobs recode a bounded set of current rows or compact the database. They check captured row/view versions and retain resources until completion or rollback settles. Automatic training, recoding, VACUUM and read-ahead each have their own qualification gates.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Frozen edit and action captures
subtitle: Values + generations + exact graph roles
Complete meaningful groups
members: Action frontier, before/after values and restoration/merge/native-Undo references
nodes.purpose: The main-thread bridge freezes complete values and action context after an edit is admitted. Background work preserves those identities and group boundaries through encoding, retry and local commit.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Fixed object bytes for saving and retry
subtitle: Changes + snapshot + descriptor encodings
One local sealer
nodes.purpose: Encoding, optional compression and integrity/encryption protection fix an object’s final bytes once. Retry uses the same sealed object; uncertain completion is checked against the committed identity.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Decoded records awaiting history checks
subtitle: Envelope + value + action + snapshot codecs
Exact nominal identities and references
members: ExactUTF8, labels, display dates and nominal ID wrappers
nodes.purpose: Decoding checks protection and size limits before constructing complete records. Their identities and references then supply inputs for checking history meaning and consistency.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Checked history and query results
subtitle: RetainedGraph or scoped CheckedQueryHistory
Exact captured prefix and occurrences
members: Operation causal ancestry and note-predecessor graph
nodes.purpose: Indexed reads check complete action membership and history relationships while decoding each object once. Query evidence records the owner, session and history/view position checked. Full-history evidence supports reconstruction and collection-wide commands.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Validated batch and durability results
subtitle: Same exact objects + dependency semantics
Acceptance transaction input/output
members: HistoryObject exact bytes with decoded contents
nodes.purpose: History validation produces a batch tied to its checked bootstrap, current-state basis or declared history. The database owner checks that context again and commits all acceptance records before issuing a durability acknowledgment.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Prepared current-state computation
subtitle: Exact logical cut + all outside-cut work
Generation-bound install result
nodes.purpose: Reduction computes current notes and related views separately from live editing and database writes. Installation checks the starting view and target history again. Publishing to the app separately checks that its live context still matches.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Snapshot capture and validation
subtitle: Frozen prefix, pages and represented cut
Separate semantic and retention checks
members: Page-stream readers, hashing and owned sink buffers
nodes.purpose: Snapshot capture builds bounded roots and pages incrementally. Assembly checks the entire page tree, counts and digest. Separate checks verify the represented history and the required objects named by snapshot retention parents.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Receive and discovery work
subtitle: Requirements, metadata batches, cursors
Bounded root → durable handoff
members: Single receive reservation and save-settlement waiters
nodes.purpose: Discovery copies observations from the owned repository, checks bounded file hints and retains unknown exact bytes for receive processing. Work yields between turns; missing and rejected prerequisites keep distinct outcomes.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Publication work and installation results
subtitle: Accepted-prefix selection + exact bytes
Provider installation separately checked
nodes.purpose: Publication captures a bounded batch of exact accepted objects, then releases the database turn before file work. It checks installation evidence against that batch and the current physical root. Provider upload status remains separate.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: File observations and output plans
subtitle: Equal shallow catalogs + selected reads
Fresh expected-current evidence
nodes.purpose: Reconciliation captures current-file observations, selected bytes and live-model versions. It checks applicability again before changing the model or files. Immutable-object discovery follows its own bounded directory traversal.
nodes.status: Adopted plaintext/Apple contracts; production projection/application integration remains Phases 6–7.

nodes.title: Pending file previews and decisions
subtitle: Latest readable vs frozen admitted input
Fresh consent and relationship claim
members: Provisional relationship claim and current content review
nodes.purpose: File review compares the selected input with one note’s active path and bytes. Reservations preserve retry identity. Fresh decisions admit a complete capture; later exact committed evidence settles its pending references.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Repair, backup and copy results
subtitle: Validated union and fixed-cut inventories
Verified replacement + activation input
nodes.purpose: Repair combines independently validated objects with surviving required private records. Backup and copy report which captured inputs they include. Activating a replacement additionally requires separately verified selection context.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Authoritative live note collection
subtitle: Shared NoteObject values + Current
Immediate admission during use
members: Automatic preservation births / independently edited conflict notes
nodes.purpose: Edits enter the complete live note store immediately. Incoming prepared changes become visible together after final checks. Pending edits stay protected until their exact history is durably saved.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Synchronous search / live indexes
subtitle: In-memory note, UUID and label indexes
Per-window current query/filter
members: UUID, label lookup and sorting structures
Host case-insensitive label lookup distinct from exact stored label tokens
nodes.purpose: All current notes and search indexes are ready before editable startup. Searching and filtering run synchronously with input processing and the same view-refresh cycle.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Pending edit versions and action context
subtitle: UUID/LSN + structural generation
Applied frontier + scope maxima
members: Open saved-edit group and exact before-state
Fresh independent action origin / previous-origin action
nodes.purpose: Each pending edit records the version and action context needed to save it faithfully. Completion clears only the generations it actually saved. A fresh editable session creates new writer-epoch and action-origin contexts.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Native undo + attached note views
subtitle: Shared per-note editing/undo owner
Independent window presentation
members: Shared live text/model owner and NSTextStorage adapter
nodes.purpose: Windows share the live note and its Undo owner while keeping their own presentation state. Native typing undo checks causal eligibility. Durable action records retain the remaining effects needed for portable Undo.
nodes.status: Adopted ownership/input contract; native bridge candidates and actual application integration remain distinct gates.

nodes.title: History / Recently Deleted views
subtitle: Paged metadata + detached previews
Restoration-aware deletion list
members: Retained branch and merge previews/diff buffers
nodes.purpose: On-demand indexed queries load exact retained history. Durable restoration evidence removes only its named source entry from Recently Deleted, even if the restored note is later deleted.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Derived merges / conflict attention
subtitle: Heads, base, derived provenance
NV alternatives + scoped Apple preview
members: Recovery key / slot / retired deterministic identity
Unresolved NV attention minus exact completed copies
Invocation-scoped resolver Current and selected member previews
nodes.purpose: Note predecessors determine alternative note heads and Current. Conservative merging preserves the exact inputs and base. Copy disposition changes attention to selected conflicts; Apple version choices retain their separate scope.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Causal Undo/Redo / reviewed commands
subtitle: Scope maxima and compensation families
Captured whole-command applicability
members: Candidate frontier, selected action and affected values
nodes.purpose: Scope parents order Undo/Redo candidates; compensation targets identify the action being reversed. Preparation and admission check the complete command again. Execution records a new action rather than rewriting earlier history.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Note-file update in progress
subtitle: Current intended + last accepted output
A → B → C source accounting
members: Captured in-flight output and original expected source
nodes.purpose: An unfinished note-file update retains the last verified representation for repair matching. If B finishes while newer C is pending, B settles only its own work. A projection receipt advances after exact file verification and completed source accounting.
nodes.status: Adopted contract; application/projection consumers remain Phases 6–7.

nodes.title: Local store / database owner
subtitle: LocalStoreSession + Database actor
Dedicated local execution resource
members: Borrowed statement/C resources with scoped final disposal
SQLite pager cache and keyed connections
Fixed-cut SQLite backup connection and job ownership
nodes.purpose: One owner serializes database work and reserves jobs before waiting. Separate background preparation and provider resources leave local saving able to proceed.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Physical repository root owner
subtitle: RepositoryRootSession / RootLane / RootLease
Retained directory-object lock
members: Local identity, loss-event resource and latched loss
Nested enumeration streams and cleanup ownership
Entered operation reservation and rooted ancestor handles
nodes.purpose: Positive evidence of the same owned directory permits physical operations and follows that directory through a move. Root/lifecycle checks surround blocking work. Closing retains ownership until entered work finishes.
nodes.status: Root ownership and coordinated effects have recorded platform qualification. Continuously owned HFS+ roots support tested deep moves/reads; fresh acquisition at a deep HFS+ path has the approved ESTALE capability-refusal limit. The P5.4 ledger records exact tested bounds.

nodes.title: Unlock context / transient crypto state
subtitle: CK → separated object/database keys
Secret and codec working buffers
members: User password / encryption recovery key input
Domain-separated HKDF object and SQLCipher keys
Nonce, bounded byte cursor, zstd/AEAD working buffers
nodes.purpose: Validated descriptors or optional Keychain input unlock the selected collection context. Encrypted provider bytes are authenticated before decompression and decoding. Password-free database encryption uses the documented public key.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Apple coordination / provider observations
subtitle: Accessor, presenter and exact-item requests
Independent bounded provider lane
members: One root NSFilePresenter / exactly-once relinquishment replies
Materialization requests and copied availability/upload status
nodes.purpose: Rooted file work runs inside Foundation’s actual coordination callback. Notifications request fresh observations. An entered callback retains its resources through delayed completion, cancellation and close.
nodes.status: P5.4 A–F is implemented and qualified within the ledger’s platform/capability limits, including the automatic driver and final-source signed two-Mac exchange. Application integration, distribution signing and physical power-loss qualification retain their separate gates.

nodes.title: Selection / transition ownership
subtitle: SelectedStoreOwner + verified context
Independent association cutover
nodes.purpose: A verified candidate and durable unlocking route precede selecting a new active store. Recovery or an explicit root switch establishes a fresh physical association and its own authority.
nodes.status: Adopted design; implementation scope is documented by the cited plans.

nodes.title: Edit, publication and close checks
subtitle: Store, root, lifecycle, view, note generations
One asynchronous lifecycle owner
members: Quit/folder switch: stop new edits, force captures and finish pending work
nodes.purpose: Each final consumer checks that its captured context still applies. Quit saves admitted history and required private state before optional provider waiting, drains or invalidates callbacks, and releases ownership last.
nodes.status: Runtime ownership/publication fences exist within headless scope; final app quit/folder-switch orchestration remains Phase 7.

excluded.name: Packed startup cache / StartupCacheV1 / startup_cache / view_changes
excluded.reason: Current-note rows and compact context are the adopted startup representation.

excluded.name: Separate NVLOC1 / NVLST1 state files and nested private object envelopes
excluded.reason: Private required-state records live in keyed SQL pages; exact unlock descriptors and selected-store record remain outside.

excluded.name: Modern application WAL, mutable shared HEAD, shared undo cursor, provider receipt/membership registry, lock child
excluded.reason: Immutable segments, causal action history, owned directory descriptors and atomic private acceptance supply their respective roles.

excluded.name: Physical page-list/read-ahead hint file
excluded.reason: Disposable physical I/O advice was investigated; it is omitted from the implemented 4F increment.

excluded.name: Co-add occupancy/path-slot identity
excluded.reason: Ordinary imports use fresh births. Experiments do not enable deterministic co-add identity.

excluded.name: Encrypted per-note projections / continuous plaintext mirror / full-history search / named restore points / permanent erase
excluded.reason: These are outside the adopted initial feature set; explicit scratch/export and retained history are represented above.

excluded.name: Durable marked-text draft / serialized NSUndoManager continuation
excluded.reason: AppKit owns provisional input and native executable undo stays transient; retained meaningful actions supply portable compensation.

excluded.name: Rich RTF/HTML codec expansion
excluded.reason: New format work is plaintext-first; legacy supported content retains preservation or explicit unsupported/conversion handling.
